summary: Fixed macros and ArcBot failing on a DFM whose triangle contains zero rows, with "DFM exclusion rows must match the corresponding ratio-value rows".
details: An origin period with a zero value has no ratio, but the live method payload recorded it as a ratio of 0, so the ratio triangle and the exclusion pattern no longer had the same shape and strict validation rejected the method.
The saved method file was never affected; only the in-memory payload handed to macros, ArcBot, and the RPC bridge.
